$why: WHAT A PHONE MAY DOWNLOAD (`PASS.md` P9). Generated shape, hand-written
numbers: `pnpm budget` measures, this file is the bar, and CI compares.
The model is `sim.golden.txt`'s: a number that may not move without a
reason in the same commit. It differs in one way and only one — a golden
file is an EXACT match and these are CEILINGS, because every code change
moves a byte count by a few hundred bytes and an exact match would fail on
every commit and be deleted by the end of the week. A ceiling with ~2%
headroom fails on a regression and not on a sentence.
To move a bar: change it here, and say why in `LOG.md` in the same commit.
That is the whole ritual, and it is the same one the golden sim has.
EVERYTHING THE FRONT DOOR PARSES BEFORE IT DRAWS — the number the
stranger test is actually about. Read off `index.html`'s own script and
stylesheet links, so it cannot go stale when a chunk is renamed.
Measured 170.3 KB gzipped on 2026-09-10. `IMPROVEMENTS.md` B8 measured
app 114.9 KB + vendor 333.1 KB = **448 KB, all of it before the door
drew a pixel** — and the 2026-09-08 lazy split moved the renderer out.

Gzip rather than brotli because gzip is the floor every browser and
every CDN agrees on; brotli is reported too and is strictly better.

THE BOARD'S OWN CHUNK — three, `@react-three/fiber`, drei and troika.
Measured 279.0 KB gzipped on 2026-09-10.
It is allowed to be large. It is not allowed to be in the first paint,
and that is a fact about the import GRAPH rather than about this number,
which is why `pnpm budget` also searches the entry chunk for the
renderer's own module specifiers. A byte count notices a leak only after
it has happened; a name is caught on the build that introduces it.
THE FOUR SELF-HOSTED FACES. Measured 149.3 KB raw on 2026-09-10.
RAW and not gzipped, and that is the honest number: woff2 is already
compressed, so gzipping it measures nothing a server would do. The TTF
is the one file that would compress, and it is the BOARD's — troika
cannot parse woff2 — so it is not in the first paint either way.
Two of the four are preloaded by `index.html`; `pnpm budget` asserts
that, because a preload the page does not use is a wasted round trip on
the first visit and a missing one is the FOUT B8.2 went and fixed.
WHAT AN OFFLINE INSTALL COSTS A PHONE'S STORAGE — the worker's own
list, read off the BUILT worker because `__PRECACHE_ASSETS__` is
substituted at build time. Measured 2043.6 KB raw over 28 files on
2026-09-10; B8 recorded 2.7 MB before its art pass and 1.8 MB after.
RAW, because storage pays raw. It is also the bar most likely to move
for a good reason: every new terrain PNG lands here. Moving it is fine;
moving it without noticing is what this file is against.
